locator: Appendix Table 5, printed p. 96, 1925 population by age and sex
published_scope: Koreans in the 1925 census of the whole Korean peninsula, 19,020,030 people
definition: Reported age by sex, using the most detailed mutually exclusive rows. The national age table excludes 502,915 non-Koreans.
opening_method: Use the 1925 joint age and sex distribution of the peninsula's predominant population as a proxy for the existing Korean Empire opening pool. Allocate integer counts by largest remainders. Retain the original opening total.
uncertainty: The census is 25 years after opening. The age shares of smaller resident groups, registration omissions, migration and the demographic change between opening and the census are unquantified.
